name: Ironheights Guard
description: Local runtime guard for high-risk OpenClaw tool calls. Append-only audit log on this machine. Blocks only in enforce mode.

mode.description: Overrides the mode in the guard policy file. monitor logs only. enforce blocks.

priority.description: before_tool_call order. OpenClaw runs higher numbers first (default 0). A block ends the chain, so the guard with the higher priority decides. Default 80.

policyPath.description: Absolute path to guard-policy.json. Defaults to ~/.ironheights/guard-policy.json.
